description: This file defines a template class 'ParserType' for parsing text streams with various states, as well as classes for parsing text fragments and file paths within the 'WPEFramework::Core' namespace. It includes method declarations for parsing, validation, and extracting structured data from text, and references several other local header files.

classes.name: ParserType
classes.description: A template class for parsing text streams with various states, supporting operations like collecting words, lines, pass-through, and deserialization of byte streams.

classes.name: TextParser
classes.description: A class for parsing text fragments, reading text, numbers, enumerations, key-value pairs, and ranges from text data.

classes.name: PathParser
classes.description: A class for parsing file path components such as drive, path, filename, extension from a text fragment.

methods.name: ReadText
methods.description: Reads text from a fragment until delimiters are encountered.

methods.name: Skip
methods.description: Skips a specified number of characters or positions in the text fragment.

methods.name: Find
methods.description: Finds specified characters within the text fragment.

methods.name: SkipLine
methods.description: Skips to the end of the current line.

methods.name: Validate
methods.description: Validates the text fragment against a comparison string, case-sensitive or insensitive.

methods.name: ReadNumber
methods.description: Reads a number of specified type from the text fragment.

methods.name: ReadEnumerate
methods.description: Reads an enumeration value from the text fragment.

methods.name: ReadKeyValuePair
methods.description: Reads a key-value pair from the text fragment.

methods.name: ReadRange
methods.description: Reads a range of numbers from the text fragment.

methods.name: Parse
methods.description: Parses a text fragment into its components (drive, path, filename, extension).
